app.title: HR System
app.tagline: Onboarding, employee file, and offboarding — one auditable workflow.

users.title: Staff & roles
users.subtitle: Create staff accounts and assign each to its responsible group
users.activeHint: Can sign in and work as normal.
users.inactiveHint: Sign-in is blocked. Their records stay untouched.
users.selfHint: You cannot deactivate or demote your own account — ask another administrator.
users.sendInvitationHint: They receive the sign-in link and a temporary password, and must choose their own password the first time they sign in.
users.tempPasswordOptional: Leave empty to generate one automatically.
users.resendConfirm: Send a new invitation to {name}? The previous temporary password stops working.
users.tempPasswordShown: No invitation was sent, so this is the only time the password is shown. Pass it on to {name} yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System configuration (administrators only)
settings.gmailHint: Gmail requires an App Password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords), not your normal password.
settings.consoleHint: Emails are written to the server log instead of being sent — for development.
settings.testSent: Test email sent — check the inbox (or the server log in development mode).

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: One record for the whole journey — onboarding, employment, offboarding
employees.empty: No employees yet — start with a new hire or add existing staff directly.
employees.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, number, email, national ID…
employees.directHint: For existing staff joining the system directly — created active, with an employee number, skipping the onboarding pipeline.
employees.previewUnavailable: This file type cannot be previewed in the browser - download it to view.

assets.title: Asset custody
assets.name: Name
assets.linkHint: The employee received this link by email (in development it is also shown here).
assets.trainee: Custody can be issued during training; it follows the person into their employee file.
assets.closed: No new custody for someone who has left.

contract.externalRefHint: The contract number on the external platform, if you have it.
contract.statusHint: The contract is created and approved on the external platform. Record what happened there.
contract.approveHint: Converts the trainee into an employee: number allocated, GOSI / medical / criminal-record tracks opened.
contract.approveConfirm: Mark the contract as active and convert {name} into an employee?
contract.rejectHint: Back to drafting so the contract can be fixed and resubmitted.
contract.expireHint: The approval window closed. HR can reopen later.
contract.expireConfirm: Mark the contract as expired without approval?
contract.rejectedBanner: The platform rejected this contract. Fix the details and submit again.

login.subtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
login.unreachable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.help: Trouble signing in? Your HR admin can reset your access.
login.invalid: That email and password do not match. Give it another try.
login.eyebrow: One team, one file per employee
login.headline: From the first day of training to the last day of work, every step in its place.
login.sub: Hiring, contracts, insurance, custody and offboarding, followed from one screen, with reminders reaching the right person on time.
login.internal: For internal use by the Riyada team only.

publicForm.title: Complete your onboarding data
publicForm.fileHint: Accepted files: PDF, JPG, PNG, DOC — up to 10 MB each.
publicForm.requiredHint: All documents marked * are required before submitting.
publicForm.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
publicForm.invalidHint: The link may have expired or already been used. Please contact HR for a new one.
publicForm.doneTitle: Thank you! Your data was submitted.
publicForm.doneHint: HR will review your documents and contact you with the next step.
publicForm.allRequired: All fields are required (*). The form takes only a few minutes.
publicForm.fixErrors: Please correct the highlighted fields before submitting.

approval.title: Your employment contract
approval.hint: By clicking Approve, you electronically accept this contract.
approval.doneHint: Your employee profile ({no}) has been created. HR will contact you with your onboarding details.

offboarding.title: Offboarding
offboarding.interviewDone: The employee completed the exit interview.
offboarding.interviewPending: Waiting for the employee to complete the form.
offboarding.noAssets: No approved custody items registered to this employee.
offboarding.unreturnedWarning: {n} item(s) must be returned before the termination notice.
offboarding.settlementLater: The settlement form opens when the record reaches the settlement stage.
offboarding.closeHint: Amounts saved — a Finance user closes the file after payout.
offboarding.closedAt: File closed on {date}. The employee is now inactive.
offboarding.stopsOpenWork: Starting offboarding stops every open item on the file (undecided custody forms, live links, in-progress GOSI / medical cards). Approved custody stays for the return step.

exitInterview.title: Exit interview
exitInterview.intro: We appreciate your time with us — your honest answers help us improve.
exitInterview.leavingReason: What is your reason for leaving?
exitInterview.experience: How was your experience working with us?
exitInterview.doneHint: Your answers were recorded. We wish you all the best!

bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet — reminders and escalations will appear here.

ownership.title: Status ownership
ownership.subtitle: Which group handles each workflow status — changes apply immediately
ownership.atLeastOne: At least one group must own a status.
ownership.hint: A user outside the owning group gets no action buttons and a 403 from the API. ADMIN always has access. New records and existing ones follow the change immediately.

calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.subtitle: Defines what a "working day" means for the automation deadlines
calendar.weekendHint: Selected days are excluded when counting working days. Changes apply on the next scheduler check.
calendar.noHolidays: No holidays added yet — they are also excluded from working-day counts.
calendar.name: Holiday name
calendar.generateHint: Adds Founding Day, National Day, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha (Umm al-Qura calendar). Eid dates follow the reference calendar — adjust after official announcements if needed.

sla.title: Automation rules
sla.subtitle: Reminders, escalations and deadlines — evaluated every few minutes
sla.hint: Changes apply on the next scheduler tick (within minutes). ESCALATE fires once per record after reminders were ignored.
sla.expireHint: EXPIRE closes the record automatically. It only takes effect on the onboarding waiting stages (awaiting form / awaiting approval).
sla.ccHint: Extra addresses that receive every staff message from this rule.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Live numbers across all stages — with Excel exports

expiryDocs.title: Documents & expiry
expiryDocs.empty: No tracked documents — add Iqama, passport, or the contract end date to get automatic expiry alerts.
expiryDocs.renewHint: Changing the expiry date (renewal) resets the alerts — the system will remind again before the new date.

assetApproval.title: Asset custody form
assetApproval.hint: By approving, you electronically confirm receipt of the items above and accept responsibility for them.
assetApproval.approvedHint: The items are now registered to your employee file.
assetApproval.rejectedHint: HR has been notified and will follow up with you.

profile.dataComplete: All data and documents are complete
profile.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the employee and everything attached: documents, contract, processes, custody forms, offboardings and requests. It cannot be undone. For real ex-employees use offboarding instead — delete is for wrongly created or test records.

requests.title: Requests & services
requests.empty: No requests yet — use the buttons above to log one.

contractCard.title: Contract
contractCard.none: No contract on file yet — it is drafted during the contract-creation stage (direct-added staff have none).

fields.name: Name
fields.comboHint: Pick from the list, or type a new value and press Tab to add it

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.newHireHint: Opens the onboarding pipeline: the new hire receives a signed link to complete their data and documents, then approves the contract electronically. The employee number is assigned on activation.
onboarding.docsHint: The default document checklist (ID, qualification, photo, IBAN letter) is created automatically.
onboarding.missingNotes: What is missing? (sent to the new hire)
onboarding.activated: Contract approved — the employee was activated with number {no}.
onboarding.sendNow: Send the data form by e-mail immediately after creation

ai.assistantSubtitle: Ask about employees, onboarding, documents and offboarding — answers come from live system data
ai.askPlaceholder: Ask a question… e.g. whose Iqama expires this month?
ai.emptyChat: Start by asking a question — Arabic or English.
ai.scanHint: Upload a photo or PDF of the document — the fields are filled automatically for your review.
ai.scanned: Fields filled from the document — review before saving.

validation.spl: 4 letters followed by 4 digits, e.g. RRRD2929
validation.iban: Enter a valid Saudi IBAN (SA + 22 digits)

hints.project: Set by HR — contact them if this looks wrong

emailLog.title: Email history
emailLog.subtitle: Every message the system sent — who, what, when, and whether it arrived.
emailLog.subject: Subject
emailLog.resent: Resent — a fresh copy is on its way.
emailLog.emptyHint: Messages appear here the moment the system sends them.

emailTemplates.title: Email templates
emailTemplates.subtitle: Edit what the system says. Placeholders fill in automatically for each recipient.
emailTemplates.revertConfirm: Discard your edits and go back to the built-in text?
emailTemplates.name: Template name
emailTemplates.subject: Subject
emailTemplates.bodyHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Click a placeholder to insert it at the cursor.
emailTemplates.ctaHint: Shown only when the message carries a link.
emailTemplates.useEditedHint: Off keeps your edit on file but sends the built-in text.
emailTemplates.previewHint: Rendered with sample data, exactly as the recipient will see it.

triggers.title: Status triggers
triggers.subtitle: Send a template automatically the moment a record enters a status.
triggers.emptyHint: The built-in emails (form invite, contract approval…) still go out on their own. Triggers add to them.
triggers.note: Triggers fire after the change is saved, so a failed change never sends an email.
triggers.ccHint: Type an address and press Enter. Each address gets its own copy; remove yourself here when you are done checking.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this trainee
withdraw.hint: Every open item on this file stops: pending links, undecided custody forms, GOSI / medical cards in progress. Nothing is deleted — the history stays.
withdraw.banner: This trainee withdrew. The record is kept for reference; nothing further will happen on it.
withdraw.stopped: Stopped: {links} link(s), {forms} custody form(s), {processes} process card(s).

responsibility.title: Primary follow-up owners
responsibility.subtitle: People who receive the reminders for each process, in addition to the role group of the current status. This never limits who may act.
responsibility.hint: The owning role group always receives the reminder; the people named here receive it as well. Escalations go to the escalation group.

changePassword.title: Set your password
changePassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
changePassword.forcedHint: One quick step before you start.
changePassword.forcedBanner: Welcome, {name}. You signed in with a temporary password — please choose your own to continue.
changePassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
changePassword.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one.
changePassword.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.

cmdk.noResults: Nothing matches. Try a name, an employee number or a page.
cmdk.hint: Type to search · ↑↓ to move · ↵ to open · Esc to close
